searchText: There is that other thing https://x.com/apruden08/status/2022352290888454457 Unfortunately, we are still years away from vetting a proper quantum-resistant algorithm for all parts of the stack that are also scalable (ECDSA signatures for tx signing, KZG commitments, BLS 12-381 signatures for consensus). Framed Transactions (as I understand them) are merely an intermediate step to prepare Ethereum for a future transition to new quantum resistant algorithms. Certainly important, but not time sensitive and with minimal direct user benefits on its own.
